title: AI Engram bank compressed by Mirror basis
hypothesis: A rank-4 shared basis with per-memory Mirror coefficients will preserve causal memory behavior (sufficiency, reactivation, specificity, necessity) with fewer serialized bytes than an exact closed-form Engram trace bank. A matched PCA coefficient control is expected to perform identically and is the strongest counter-hypothesis for Mirror-specific value.
physical_object: shared basis over 8x8 closed-form Engram memory traces
logical_multiplicity: independent key-value memories addressed by their own trace coefficients
controls: exact closed-form AI Engram trace bank
matched rank-4 PCA reconstruction without Mirror naming
small private residual fallback if basis error exceeds development threshold
task: Synthetic key-value memory binding; report sufficiency MSE, reactivation cosine, specificity leakage, necessity ablation effect, actual serialized bytes and per-memory bytes.

development.selection_metric: development causal metric preservation vs actual payload bytes; rank fixed at 4 before audit

fresh.split: 8 development traces estimate shared basis; each fresh world has 24 memory traces, 16 low-rank aligned and 8 residual/private boundary memories; 8 keys per memory

paid_objects: private residuals and indices if used

success_gate: On >=2/3 fresh worlds, aligned memories preserve sufficiency/reactivation/necessity within 5% and specificity leakage within 5% of exact Engram, with actual payload <=50% exact bank. Report residual-memory boundary and PCA equivalence; do not claim Mirror-specific novelty if PCA matches.
failure_gate: FAIL if aligned causal preservation or <=50% payload gate fails on >=2/3 seeds, or if residual/private memories fail and no private fallback is useful. PROMISING is scoped compression evidence even if PCA control matches, but not Mirror-specific benefit.
boundaries: PCA-equivalent control directly tests Mirror specificity
no natural continual-learning or language model claim
number of addresses is not independent capacity absent causal tests
